_comment: Edit this file to change the About page. No rebuild needed. Team photos go in resources/com/bloodlink/images/team/ using the 'photo' name below; gallery images go in resources/com/bloodlink/images/ using the 'image' name. Nothing in this file names a file path on screen -- the About page is shown to an audience, not to whoever maintains it.
story: BloodLink exists because finding a matching blood donor in an emergency is still, for most people in Bangladesh, a matter of phoning around and hoping. The people who need blood are rarely in a position to run a search, and the people willing to give it have no way of knowing they are needed.

The app keeps a verified donor register, matches a request to the donors who are actually eligible and actually close by, and puts the two in direct contact. Nothing here is a marketplace: blood is never bought or sold through BloodLink, and donors are never paid.
